blocks.text: The Transfer Upgrade is an active exporter. External pipes pull through the exposed sided inventory. Both must respect the item-automation master setting and the face’s output mode. An Input or Disabled face is not an output face.

Greenhouse chest import and export are separate directions on the front-facing connection. An Output-only front can export produce but cannot import seeds. An Input-only front can import seeds but cannot export produce. Auto may allow both for that program.

rows: Manually complete one batch with empty output slots.
Set the desired face to Output and connect an inventory whose facing side accepts the result.
Check machine.<id>.itemAutomation and the Transfer Upgrade’s actual presence/count.
Remove input-only or Disabled faces from the export route.
Fill the destination deliberately and verify that products remain pending rather than disappearing.
Change the side back and retest. A pipe’s own filter, channel, or extraction rule can still refuse the item.

blocks.text: Energy ports are governed by energy side and adapter policies, not just item-automation switches. Test the item and energy routes separately.
